drum-pad.title: Drumpad
drum-pad.description: An interactive online drumpad that allows you to play various drum sounds using your keyboard or mouse. Perfect for music enthusiasts and aspiring drummers.

gps-viewer.title: GPS Viewer
gps-viewer.description: A real-time GPS tracking application that displays your current location on an interactive map. Features position history and accuracy indicators using weighted averaging for enhanced precision.

nearest-mountpoint.title: Nearest Mount Point Finder
nearest-mountpoint.description: Find the nearest NTRIP mount point in the ASG-EUPOS network

reaction-time.title: Reaction Time
reaction-time.description: A web-based application to measure and track your reaction time. Test your reflexes and compare results with previous attempts.

blind-test.title: Blind Test
blind-test.description: A web application designed to facilitate unbiased product testing by implementing a double-blind methodology.

color-matcher.title: Color Matcher
color-matcher.description: A tool that helps you find the closest matching named colors from CSS and Material Design palettes for any color input. Supports various color formats including hex, RGB, and color names.
